material_errors.question: audit-01/q4
material_errors.claim_quote: NovaMart CISO/DPO must confirm the Munich firewall in writing (Clause SL.1(2))
material_errors.problem: SL.1(2) sets the telemetry firewall as a continuing condition but does not require written CISO/DPO confirmation before allotment; CISO and DPO authorization appears only in B.2(b), for cross-border access.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: Neither KroneVolt GmbH, its Munich R&D engineers, nor its nominee director shall receive API keys, bulk telemetry exports, or remote SSH access to Indian customer IoT data or AWS ap-south-1/ap-south-2 KMS realms, maintaining strict compliance with Schedule B (Clause B.2).

material_errors.question: audit-01/q2
material_errors.claim_quote: Deductions are credit-note based, so they interact with CGST Section 34 adjustments and remain outside the MSA Clause 9.1 cap analysis.
material_errors.problem: Section 34 credit notes appear only for volume rebates in SL.3, and no document says Addendum A peak deductions sit outside the Clause 9.1 aggregate cap.

material_errors.question: audit-02/q4
material_errors.claim_quote: so peak LDs and GST debits are the only uncapped recovery routes
material_errors.problem: Peak LDs are excluded from the 3.25% ceiling but are themselves capped at 6.50% of Festive Peak PO landed value, so they are not uncapped; 'only' also ignores the Clause 9.2 uncapped carve-outs.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: Combined dock fees and fill-rate deductions under Clause A.4 are capped at 6.50% of total Festive Peak PO landed value

material_errors.question: audit-02/q2
material_errors.claim_quote: A final order against Deccan would not be capped, because MSA Cl. 9.2(b)(iii) and TAX-GST-ITC-2026 Cl. D.4 keep tax-fraud indemnity uncapped.
material_errors.problem: The Maharashtra demand is Deccan's own non-fraud Section 73 tax dispute, whereas the uncapped carve-out covers indemnifying NovaMart for fraudulent invoicing, blocked ITC under Section 16(2)(c), Section 74 fraud proceedings or unreimbursed tax assessments, so applying it here is unsupported.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: non-fraud classification confirmed after withdrawal of initial Section 74 allegations

material_errors.question: audit-02/q4
material_errors.claim_quote: The 6.5% cap exceeds the 3.25% ceiling, so the two are not stackable.
material_errors.problem: The 3.25% ceiling expressly excludes Addendum A Clause A.4 Peak liquidated damages, so the two caps are independent and can apply cumulatively; nothing supports a 'not stackable' conclusion.
material_errors.source_quote_or_absent: (EXPRESSLY EXCLUDING punitive Peak SLA liquidated damages assessed under Addendum A Clause A.4 and GST escrow/debit adjustments under Schedule D) shall NEVER exceed a hard contractual ceiling of 3.25%
